title: Clubs (skill)

infobox.Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Clubs (skill).

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Clubs (skill) is a skill related to Clubs weapons class.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Higher skill level in clubs reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

sections.heading: Leveling up
sections.text: The player gains 1.5xp per one-handed attack and 1xp per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.

full_text:
Clubs (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Clubs (skill).

Introduction. Clubs (skill) is a skill related to Clubs weapons class.

Effects. Higher skill level in clubs reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

Leveling up. The player gains 1.5xp per one-handed attack and 1xp per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.
